products.name: Application Control (WDAC) — Commercial
products.short_description: Allowlist trusted code and block everything else — Audit-first, with recovery. Deploy WDAC yourself with self-guided, tested steps for far less than consulting.
products.description:
Kernel-enforced allowlisting — deployed safely

Antivirus asks “is this file known-bad?” Application Control asks the stronger question: “is this code explicitly trusted?” — and blocks everything else. WDAC is kernel-enforced allowlisting that stops untrusted executables, scripts, and installers from running at all. Rolled out Audit-first with a clear recovery path, it delivers powerful protection without locking your users out.

Run it yourself — simpler, cheaper, and proven

You do not need a consultant on site to deploy Application Control (WDAC). This package hands you the exact, field-tested method as self-guided, click-by-click documentation that a non-expert administrator can follow from start to finish — backed by ready-to-run PowerShell scripts that do the heavy lifting. You implement with confidence, on your own schedule, and keep the playbook forever.

  • Simpler — exact navigation in the right order, written for a novice admin. Click to implement; the “why” lives in the overview so the steps stay short and uncluttered.
  • Cheaper — one fixed, transparent price instead of an open meter. A comparable consulting engagement runs $1,500–$3,000 per day across several days; this is a fraction of that, with nothing left to bill.
  • Tested — a pilot-first method (Assess → Configure → Pilot → Validate → Expand) with validation scripts and clear pass/fail gates, so you know it worked before you roll out to the fleet.

What's inside

  • Solution Overview — allowlisting, the trust models, and Audit/Enforce modes.
  • Requirements Guide — every prerequisite with verify/implement steps.
  • Implementation Guide — exact, ordered steps: Audit → add trust → Enforce, with a documented recovery path.
  • 5 PowerShell scripts — policy discovery, validation, audit-event reporting, recovery/remediation, and tenant policy reporting.
  • Testing & Troubleshooting Guides with pass/fail gates, plus Best Practices.

The repeatable way

Every solution follows the same repeatable shape, so each one you deploy feels familiar and low-risk — and your team gets faster and more confident with every rollout. Buy once, deploy to unlimited devices, and reuse the playbook for the next wave and the next project.

The bottom line

Strong, kernel-enforced protection against untrusted code — including unknown malware and unsanctioned apps — deployed safely with audit-first validation, managed-installer trust, and a recovery path that keeps you in control.

What you receive — every file in your download

This package is delivered as downloadable files you keep and reuse across unlimited devices — nothing is left out and nothing else is required:

  • Implementation Guide (PDF) — the complete, click-by-click solution: solution overview, requirements, step-by-step implementation, testing & validation, troubleshooting, best practices.
  • PowerShell Scripts (ZIP) — 5 ready-to-run scripts (read-only discovery/validation/reporting; remediation defaults to a safe preview):
    • WDAC-AuditReport.ps1 — summarize Code Integrity audit/block events for App Control
    • WDAC-Discovery.ps1 — App Control (WDAC) readiness and current code-integrity status
    • WDAC-PolicyReport.ps1 — tenant-wide App Control (WDAC) policy + assignment report (Graph)
    • WDAC-Remediation.ps1 — recovery for an over-strict App Control policy: refresh/clear and sync
    • WDAC-Validation.ps1 — confirm an App Control (WDAC) policy is active and report its mode

Delivered as a branded Word document and PDF, plus all five PowerShell scripts in a single ZIP — yours to keep and reuse across unlimited devices.
